title: Kill switch: confirm
description: Stopping all orders asks for a reason and whether to cancel open orders.

title: Kill switch engaged
description: With the kill switch on, every new order from every tool is refused until an admin releases it.

title: API keys with scopes
description: A new key is shown once; every key lists its scopes (read, paper, admin), accounts, client and expiry.

title: Confirming an AI-prepared order
description: An order prepared by Claude over MCP: every field is shown before a person confirms it. Nothing is sent until then.

title: Request log
description: Every request from scripts, charts, Excel and AI tools: method, path, status, time and key id.
